summary: Implemented the SHACL path parsing feature. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes, plus a separate test for non-node inputs. Tests run with the shared venv: test_extras and test_path.py gave 119 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing was committed. mypy, ruff, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placement, line lengths, and import order were checked by reading the code only.
